description: Operational status check. The backend may perform idempotent fulfilment when Stripe confirms payment but webhook delivery is delayed; that can create the appointment Calendar event and send booking notifications. Returns only booking status and appointment date/time, not client contact details, payment credentials, event links or calendar notes. Enabled only when the Preview test gate or Production live-booking gate is explicitly configured. Tell the client the appointment is confirmed only when both paid and confirmed are true.

bookingId.description: Exact booking identifier returned by create_checkout_session. Use it to check payment and appointment confirmation; do not substitute a client name or email.

name: get_agent_booking_status
title: Verify an AI-agent booking payment and confirmation
